pending_part_2.voiceover_script: Government secrets can ruin lives, but this classified cover-up nearly ended them. In Part 1, we explored the terrifying night three witnesses encountered a burning diamond UFO escorted by military helicopters... but when they arrived at the hospital hours later, doctors were horrified. All three victims suffered severe hair loss, blinding blisters, and catastrophic organ failure—symptoms of acute nuclear radiation poisoning. When the victims filed a twenty-million-dollar lawsuit against the United States military, officials made a shocking claim under oath: no such aircraft existed in the military inventory, and no helicopters flew that night. Yet radar logs and multiple independent witnesses confirmed the giant formation. Declassified documents later revealed a secret military project testing an experimental nuclear-powered craft that suffered a catastrophic meltdown right above that Texas highway.
